**Sarah Anne Page**

Sarah Anne Page (born 1975) is a British aristocrat and socialite, known for her philanthropic work in the fields of education and healthcare. **Early Life and Education**

Sarah Anne Page was born on August 12, 1975, to Lord Thomas Page and Lady Elizabeth Page (née Windsor) in London, England. She is a descendant of the prominent Page family, who have held titles and estates in England since the 15th century. Page was educated at the prestigious Wycombe Abbey School and later attended the University of Oxford, where she earned a degree in History. **Marriage and Family**

On June 15, 2002, Sarah Anne Page married David Norton, a businessman and philanthropist, at a private ceremony at St. Mary's Church in London. The couple has two children, Emily Elizabeth Norton (born 2005) and James Thomas Norton (born 2008). **Philanthropic Work**

Page is a dedicated philanthropist, focusing on education and healthcare initiatives. She has served on the boards of several charitable organizations, including the Royal College of Nursing and the British Red Cross. In 2010, she founded the Page-Norton Foundation, which provides educational resources and healthcare services to underprivileged communities.
